# RtMidi 6.0.0

MIDI input for Lumen's MIDI control (batch 19): realtime MIDI i/o C++ classes by Gary P. Scavone, from https://github.com/thestk/rtmidi (tag 6.0.0), MIT licence (see LICENSE). `RtMidi.h` and `RtMidi.cpp` are unchanged. The build compiles them with ALSA on Linux, Windows Multimedia on Windows and CoreMIDI on macOS.
